question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Scrupulous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Immoral**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Scrupulous"** refers to someone who is extremely careful, precise, and ethical in their actions. It also means being very attentive to detail and having strong moral principles. (ईमानदार, नैतिक रूप से सही)

 
 
• **Example: **The scrupulous accountant ensured every transaction was recorded accurately.
 
 
 
• **"Immoral"** means not conforming to accepted standards of morality, or lacking ethical principles. It is the direct antonym of scrupulous. (अनैतिक)
 
 
• **Example: **Stealing from the poor is considered an immoral act in every society.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'scrupulous'** is **'immoral'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Immoral**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Someone who is truthful, sincere, and free of deceit.

 
 
• **Example:** The honest shopkeeper returned the wallet to its rightful owner.
 
 
 
• **Conscientious** (कर्तव्यनिष्ठ): Someone who is diligent and careful, especially when it comes to doing what is morally right.
 
 
• **Example:** A conscientious teacher always ensures that every student understands the concepts.
 
 
 
• **Ethical** (नैतिक): Relating to moral principles or the branch of knowledge dealing with what is right and wrong.
 
 
• **Example:** The company was praised for its ethical business practices.

The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Beginner.
